items.title: Before Kawhi, there was Wilt: In 1965, Chamberlain re-signed with the 76ers, with a secret verbal provision from Sixers ownership that Wilt would gain a significant portion of team ownership after he retired if he stayed. items.author: Known-Peak212
items.body_excerpt: It was verbal, rather than written, because it was against league rules for an active player to own a percentage of a team.
